_meta.status: EMPTY — MESH STORE LOCATED, DECODE BLOCKED. The customization item meshes are the 2,546 embedded custom-DEFLATE 'GZIP' containers inside the 81 MB bin_e6.2 archive (bulk_decrypted.bin, DATA401 IDX entry 87) — located and sample-tested first-hand by this lane (300-container sample with the existing EBOOT-faithful decoder: 6 byte-exact, all small u32 index tables, zero meshes; the mesh-bearing containers are the blocked population — see survey doc). They share the one remaining DATA401 decode defect: the containers were encoded against a decode context the EBOOT's bundled inflate does not provide (proven by executing the game's own inflate under Unicorn, PR #413); 20/76 top-level containers decode byte-exact, the dynamic-block population does not. The PPSSPP live-trace lane (teardown sweep round 4) owns the crack. parts[] stays empty until real decoded meshes land; parts then drop in additively in this exact shape. named_gaps[] below is documentation only — it is NOT part of parts[], the runtime never resolves it, and resolveProfileParts() reports a named-gap part_id as 'unresolved' (never silently dropped) until the real part lands in parts[]. SECOND GAP: the sbcustomize_item_t definition array (slot/price/character/model-pack per item) is NOT located (PR #416) — the 9,440 held name records key by (table, item_idx) only, so no name can yet be authoritatively assigned a slot, character, or container. Mesh-side evidence is the authority when the decode lands.
_meta.suite_slot_mapping: T6 slot -> suite_slot (per tekken6-slot-catalog.json wh_suite_slot): head->hair, upper_body->upper_body, lower_body->lower_body, other->accessory. DIVERGENCES from the T7 16-slot schema: (1) T6 has FOUR slots, not sixteen — T6 'head' (slot_id 1) is a single bucket carrying hats/helmets/masks/glasses/hairstyles/facial hair, which T7 splits into HEAD/HAIR/FULL_HEAD/HAIR_ACC/GLA/FACE/FACE_HAIR/MAKE_UP; (2) the held T6 schema maps its head slot to suite_slot 'hair' — this catalog follows the held schema, and head-gear items (masks/helmets/glasses) will need a suite_slot refinement (head/full_head/glasses/face per content) at import time, recorded per entry, never silently; (3) T6 'other' (slot_id 4) covers auras/effects/weapons/companions, which T7 splits into UPPER_ACC/LOWER_ACC/EXTRA/Effects/Aura — the T6 schema's own t7_slot_map says slot 4 fans out to T7 12/13/14 by item type; (4) T6 slot_ids are strings in the held schema ('1'..'4'); catalog entries carry them as integers. Scope: T6 item tables are per-character lists (item_idx is per-table, range 1-160); a 'generic' scope can only be asserted from the definition array or the decoded pack layout (CUSTOMIZEPACK%d_%d / HAIRCUSTOMIZEPACK%d patterns in the EBOOT), never from the name tables alone.
